_comment: Per-file line coverage thresholds (%). Files not listed default to 'default'.
_comment_tooling: tools/library-panic-audit/* and tools/api-dump/src/main.rs: CLI entry points and the panic-audit parser/error surface are exercised deterministically by scripts/test-audit-library-panics.py subprocess fixtures (which llvm-cov cannot attribute to in-process unit tests) or are convenience binaries without a coverage contract. audit.rs is pinned at 60 (currently ~61%), main.rs at 0. Reassess when the self-test suite is wired into an in-process harness.
_comment_xtask: xtask/src/main.rs: developer utility binary with no coverage contract.
_comment_test_utils: crates/tensor4all-partitionedtt/src/test_utils.rs: test-support code compiled into the lib target but only exercised from test modules; pinned at 0.
_comment_capi: crates/tensor4all-capi/{hdf5,simplett,tensorci,types}.rs: C API binding surfaces whose release-mode coverage is lower than the default because the FFI constructors/helpers are exercised from Tensor4all.jl integration tests and the capi test suite runs under nextest with HDF5 excluded; thresholds record the current measured release percentages (0/40/55/69).
_comment_expensive_algorithms: crates/tensor4all-simplett/src/mpo/* and crates/tensor4all-treetn/src/{treetn/fit,operator/mod}.rs: expensive MPO/fitting algorithms whose heavy paths are covered by focused integration tests (tests/fit_*.rs, examples) rather than the default unit suite; thresholds record measured release percentages (15/17/25/66/0).
_comment_reference_crates: crates/tensor4all-core/src/tensor_index.rs, crates/mdarray-einsum/src/typed_tensor.rs, crates/tensor4all-itensorlike/src/linsolve.rs: reference/legacy surfaces pinned at measured values (0/45/0).
_comment_boundary_modules: crates/tensor4all-tensorbackend/src/storage.rs (72) and crates/tensor4all-hdf5/src/compat.rs (62): storage/compat internals partially exercised only through higher-level consumers; keep the current measured values.
_comment_dmrg_release_only: crates/tensor4all-treetn/src/dmrg/mod.rs: a release-only deficit. Debug coverage is 77.2% (the debug profile executes debug_assert paths that release compiles out); release measures 72.4%. The DMRG sweep paths are exercised by tests/tdvp.rs and the dmrg/gse integration tests. Pinned at 72; revisit when release-mode path tests are added.
